Registration fee: 5000 WON for first event, 3000 WON for each additional event. * Please transfer money to this account: IBK Bank 299-079830-02-011 (유병선) * No registration will be allowed at the venue. * ***No refunds***, except if you transferred money and did not make the competitor list. * Registration on this website + money transfer = completion of registration
